list.expr: {job="integrations/kubernetes/eventhandler", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespacepattern", type="Warning", kind="Pod", name=~"$pod"} | logfmt | line_format "{{.reason}}: {{.name}} — {{.msg}}"
list.name: K8s Warning Events

list.expr: {job="integrations/kubernetes/eventhandler", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespacepattern", type="Normal", kind="Pod", name=~"$pod"} | logfmt | reason="Killing" | line_format "Killing {{.name}} — {{.msg}}"
list.name: Pod Killed

list.expr: {job="integrations/kubernetes/eventhandler", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespacepattern", kind=~"Deployment|StatefulSet", name=~"($pod_controller).*"} | logfmt | line_format "{{.kind}} {{.name}}: {{.reason}} — {{.msg}}"
list.name: Rollouts / Deployments

list.expr: (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespacepattern", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0) and on (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespacepattern", pod=~"$pod", reason="OOMKilled"} == 1)
list.name: OOMKilled
